obligations.source_text: Stress-test the current fantasy visual semantics by rendering the agent-selected magic circle plus living armor pair in a complex photorealistic scene, using the attached portrait only as visible appearance guidance for an original adult fictional woman.

bindings.boundary_phrase: one complete closed boundary remains visible without cropped gaps
bindings.surface_phrase: the boundary conforms to a real floor wall table or object surface
bindings.difference_phrase: light material motion or state differs visibly inside versus outside
bindings.stop_phrase: the fictional effect terminates bends or changes exactly at the boundary line
bindings.residue_phrase: dust liquid shadow scorch or object contact records the local rule
